scripts.db:generate: node scripts/ensure-prisma-link.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/ensure-prisma-link.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma --name init
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/ensure-prisma-link.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs node scripts/run-seed.mjs
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/ensure-prisma-link.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs prisma migrate reset --schema prisma/schema.prisma --force
scripts.db:studio: node scripts/ensure-prisma-link.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
